title: 电子废弃物
summary: 评估公司电子废弃物回收与处理管理，适用于电子制造、IT设备相关行业。

sections.title_cn: 引言

blocks.content: This document provides essential information on the components of the Electronic Waste Key Issue to enable users of ESG Ratings to understand how MSCI Sustainability & Climate’s (MSCI S&C’s)1 outputs are determined. Electronic Waste is a Key Issue in the Environmental Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on their production of electronic waste, their potential exposure to electronic waste regulations and their efforts at product collection and recycling.
blocks.content_cn: 本文件介绍电子废弃物关键议题各组成部分的核心信息，帮助 ESG 评级使用者理解 MSCI 可持续发展与气候团队（MSCI S&C）¹ 如何形成评估结果。电子废弃物属于 MSCI ESG 评级模型环境支柱下的关键议题。公司评估涵盖其电子废弃物产生情况、电子废弃物法规带来的潜在风险敞口，以及产品回收和再循环措施。

blocks.content: For additional details on the MSCI ESG Ratings Model, refer to the Data, ratings and scores section of “ESG Ratings Methodology.”
blocks.content_cn: 关于MSCI ESG评级模型的更多细节，请参阅《ESG评级方法论》中"数据、评级和分数"部分。

sections.title_cn: 电子废弃物关键议题得分

blocks.content: The Electronic Waste Key Issue score evaluates the company’s level of exposure to, and management of, risks on this Key Issue. The Key Issue score on this Key Issue is based on the Exposure score and the Management score using the formula below. The Exposure score and the Management score are combined such that a higher level of exposure requires a higher level of demonstrated management capability in order to achieve the same overall Key Issue score.

blocks.content: This score is derived from indicators that are scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to best practice. Refer to the Analyzing risk management section of “ESG Ratings Methodology” for additional details. Sources are company disclosures except where otherwise indicated.

sections.title_cn: 电子废弃物实践得分

blocks.content: The Electronic Waste Practices score evaluates the company’s ability to manage risks related to electronic-waste generation, product take-back and recycling programs. This score considers attributes of the company's policies and initiatives. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong initiatives.
blocks.content_cn: 电子废弃物实践得分评估公司管理电子废弃物产生、产品回收及再循环计划相关风险的能力。该得分考察公司政策与举措的特征，采用 0—10 分制，10 分表示相关举措有力。

sections.title_en: • Scope of the electronic waste take-back program by product type
sections.title_cn: • 电子废弃物回收计划的产品类型覆盖范围

blocks.content: Definition: The scope of products that are eligible for collection and recycling under the company’s electronic waste product recycling program.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司电子废弃产品再循环计划中，符合收集及再循环条件的产品范围。

sections.title_en: • Scope of the electronic waste take-back program by location
sections.title_cn: • 电子废弃物回收计划的地域覆盖范围

blocks.content: Definition: The geographic scope of the company’s product collection and electronic waste recycling program.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司产品收集与电子废弃物再循环计划的地域覆盖范围。

sections.title_en: • Scope of electronic waste take-back programs
sections.title_cn: • 电子废弃物回收计划的覆盖范围

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company’s return channels for end-of-life products - drop-off, mail-in, and pick-up. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong initiatives.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司的报废产品返还渠道，包括送交、邮寄及上门收取。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表相关举措有力。

sections.title_en: ◦ Electronic waste take-back programs include drop-off of end-of-life products
sections.title_cn: ◦ 电子废弃物回收计划包含报废产品送交渠道

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether channels for consumers to return end-of-life electronics to the company include drop-off options (at a store or designated drop-off locations).
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明消费者向公司返还报废电子产品的渠道是否包括送交选项，例如送至门店或指定收集点。

blocks.content: o Electronic waste take-back programs include mail-in of end-of-life products Definition: Indicates whether available channels for consumers to return end-of-life electronics to the company include mail-in options.
blocks.content_cn: ◦ 电子废弃物回收计划包含报废产品邮寄渠道。定义：表明消费者向公司返还报废电子产品的可用渠道是否包括邮寄选项。

sections.title_en: ◦ Electronic waste take-back programs include pick-up of end-of-life products
sections.title_cn: ◦ 电子废弃物回收计划包含报废产品上门收取渠道

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether available channels for consumers to return end-of-life electronics to the company include pick-up options.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明消费者向公司返还报废电子产品的可用渠道是否包括上门收取选项。

sections.title_en: ◦ Electronic waste take-back program exists but no details given
sections.title_cn: ◦ 存在电子废弃物回收计划但未提供详情

blocks.content: Definition Indicates whether channels exist for consumers to return end-of-life electronics to the company, but details are not provided.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明存在消费者向公司返还报废电子产品的渠道，但未提供详细信息。

sections.title_en: • Facilities that handle recycling of collected electronics
sections.title_cn: • 对收集的电子产品进行再循环处理的设施

blocks.content:
Definition: Assesses company efforts in managing electronic waste through recycling. 
Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong initiatives.
blocks.content_cn:
定义：评估公司通过再循环管理电子废弃物的措施。
以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表相关举措有力。

sections.title_cn: ◦ 公司自行运营的电子废弃物再循环设施

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company operates its own electronic waste recycling facilities. The company may also use vendors or participate in recycling management organizations for electronic waste recycling.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否自行运营电子废弃物再循环设施。公司也可使用服务商或参与回收管理组织开展电子废弃物再循环。

sections.title_en: ◦ Participation in electronic waste recycling programs
sections.title_cn: ◦ 参与电子废弃物再循环计划

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates that the company participates in electronic waste (e-waste) recycling management organizations (or recycling consortia/network) that support or operate recycling facilities. The company may also operate its own facilities or use vendors for ewaste recycling.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司参与了支持或运营再循环设施的电子废弃物回收管理组织（或回收联盟／网络）。公司也可自行运营设施或使用服务商开展电子废弃物再循环。

sections.title_cn: ◦ 服务商运营的电子废弃物再循环设施

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates that the company uses designated vendors that operate electronic waste (e-waste) recycling facilities. The company may also operate its own facilities or participate in recycling management organizations for e-waste recycling. Moreover, indicates whether these vendors audited or certified by the company or third-party audit programs (including but not limited to R2, e-stewards and WEEELABEX).
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司使用运营电子废弃物再循环设施的指定服务商。公司也可自行运营设施或参与回收管理组织开展电子废弃物再循环。此外，该指标表明这些服务商是否经公司或第三方审计计划审计或认证，包括但不限于 R2、电子管家（e-Stewards）和 WEEELABEX。

sections.title_cn: ◦ 未具体说明的电子废弃物再循环活动

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates that the company has a general statement on recycling electronic waste (e-waste) with no further details regarding the facilities, vendors or organizations that handle recycling of collected e-waste.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司仅对电子废弃物再循环作一般性说明，未进一步说明负责处理所收集电子废弃物的设施、服务商或组织。

sections.title_en: • Explicit ban on electronic waste exports to non-OECD countries
sections.title_cn: • 明确禁止向非经合组织国家出口电子废弃物

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company explicitly bans electronic waste exports from OECD member countries to non-OECD member countries for disposal and recovery, in accordance with the Basel Ban Amendment to the Basel Convention.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否依据《巴塞尔公约》的《巴塞尔禁令修正案》，明确禁止为处置和回收目的，将电子废弃物从经合组织成员国出口至非成员国。

sections.title_cn: 电子废弃物绩效得分

blocks.content: The Electronic Waste Performance score evaluates the company's performance on electronic waste management metrics (including recycling of electronic waste). It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
blocks.content_cn: 电子废弃物绩效得分评估公司在电子废弃物管理指标上的表现，包括电子废弃物再循环。该得分采用 0—10 分制，10 分表示表现强劲。

sections.title_en: • End of life electronic waste recycling
sections.title_cn: • 报废电子废弃物再循环利用

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company's performance on the share of electronic waste that is recovered and subsequently recycled by the company. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司回收并随后进行再循环的电子废弃物比例表现。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表表现强劲。

sections.title_en: ◦ Percentage of electronic waste recycled – Reported
sections.title_cn: ◦ 电子废弃物再循环比例——公司报告值

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates the proportion of collected end-of-life electronic waste that is successfully recycled and repurposed relative to the total end-of-life products and e-waste recovered.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明所收集的报废电子废弃物中，成功进行再循环及再利用的数量，占全部回收报废产品与电子废弃物的比例。

blocks.content: Sources: Company disclosures, Silicon Valley Toxics Coalition, Basel Action Network, GoodElectronics, Greenpeace’s Greener Electronics reports.
blocks.content_cn: 来源：公司披露；硅谷有毒物质联盟；巴塞尔行动网络；良好电子产业网络；绿色和平组织《更环保电子产品》报告。

sections.title_cn: 争议事件

blocks.content: A controversy deduction ranging from 0 to 5 points is subtracted from the overall Management score based on the severity, status, and the company’s role in the controversies facing the company on this Key Issue. The following categories of controversies are used in the assessment:
blocks.content_cn: 根据公司在该关键议题所面临争议事件的严重程度、状态以及公司所扮演的角色，从总体管理得分中扣除0至5分。评估使用以下类别的争议事件。

sections.title_cn: • 电子废弃物争议事件。

blocks.content: For more details on how controversies are included in the MSCI ESG Ratings model, refer to the Controversies cases section of “ESG Ratings Methodology.”
blocks.content_cn: 有关争议事件如何纳入MSCI ESG评级模型的更多详情，请参阅《ESG评级方法论》的“争议事件案例”部分。

sections.title_cn: 电子废弃物风险敞口得分

blocks.content: The Electronic Waste Exposure score evaluates the company’s exposure to risks on this Key Issue. It is based on the Business and Geographic Exposure scores. The Geographic Exposure score functions as a multiplier on the Business Exposure score, with an impact ranging from -50% to +50%. The Business and Geographic Exposure scores are scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to the highest risk and 0 corresponding to the lowest risk. Refer to the Analyzing risk exposure section of “ESG Ratings Methodology” for additional details. The following data sources and methodologies are used in the Exposure score calculation:
blocks.content_cn: 电子废弃物风险敞口得分评估公司在此关键议题上的风险敞口，以业务和地域风险敞口得分为基础。地域风险敞口得分作为业务风险敞口得分的乘数，影响范围为 -50% 至 +50%。业务与地域风险敞口得分均采用 0—10 分制，10 分对应最高风险，0 分对应最低风险。详情参见《ESG 评级方法论》的“风险敞口分析”章节。风险敞口得分计算采用以下数据来源和方法：

blocks.content:
$$
E X P _ { E L W , i } = B U S _ { E L W , i } ( 1 + 0 . 1 \big ( G E O _ { E L W , i } - 5 \big ) )
$$
Where:

blocks.content_cn: $E X P _ { E L W , i }$ 为公司 i 的电子废弃物风险敞口得分。

blocks.content: $B U S _ { E L W , i }$ is the Business Exposure score of company i.
blocks.content_cn: $B U S _ { E L W , i }$ 为公司 i 的业务风险敞口得分。

blocks.content: $G E O _ { E L W , i }$ is the Geographic Exposure score of company i.
blocks.content_cn: $G E O _ { E L W , i }$ 为公司 i 的地域风险敞口得分。

sections.title_cn: 业务板块敞口得分

blocks.content: The Business Segment Exposure score of a business segment is based on a mapping of the business segment as disclosed by the company to a corresponding business activity. MSCI S&C uses the Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) system along with industry-specific adjustments to define business activities. The score associated with a business activity is used to calculate a Business Segment Exposure score. Each business activity score is determined by a weighted average of the Type of Operations score and Type of Product score:
blocks.content_cn: 业务分部风险敞口得分以公司披露的业务分部与相应业务活动的映射关系为基础。MSCI 可持续发展与气候团队使用标准行业分类（SIC）体系，并结合行业特定调整来界定业务活动。业务活动对应的得分用于计算业务分部风险敞口得分。各业务活动得分由运营类型得分与产品类型得分的加权平均值确定：

blocks.content:
$$
B S E _ { E L W , j } = 0 . 3 5 \bigl ( T O O _ { E L W , j } \bigr ) + 0 . 6 5 ( T O P _ { E L W , j } )
$$
Where:
blocks.content_cn: 其中：

blocks.content: $T O O _ { E L W , j }$ is the Type of Operations score for business activity j.
blocks.content_cn: $T O O _ { E L W , j }$ 为业务活动 j 的运营类型得分。

blocks.content: $T O P _ { E L W , j }$ is the Type of Product score for business activity j.
blocks.content_cn: $T O P _ { E L W , j }$ 为业务活动 j 的产品类型得分。

blocks.content: The Type of Operations score is assessed as a qualitative assessment of whether the type of operations of a business activity involves the manufacture and/or sale of electronic equipment and devices.
blocks.content_cn: 运营类型得分通过定性评估确定，考察业务活动的运营类型是否涉及制造和／或销售电子设备与装置。

blocks.content: The Type of Product score is assessed as a qualitative assessment of whether the product category of the business activity involves the manufacture and/or sale of electronic equipment and devices. The product categories considered are consumer electronics, office electronics, household appliances and professional equipment.
blocks.content_cn: 产品类型得分通过定性评估确定，考察业务活动的产品类别是否涉及制造和／或销售电子设备与装置。所考虑的产品类别包括消费电子产品、办公电子产品、家用电器和专业设备。

sections.title_cn: 地理分区敞口得分

blocks.content: The Geographic Segment Exposure score is determined by a qualitative framework to assess countries or markets with strengthening or evolving electronic waste regulations. Higher regulation standards and wider coverage result in a higher risk exposure score for a given country or market.
blocks.content_cn: 地域分部风险敞口得分由定性框架确定，用于评估电子废弃物法规正在强化或演变的国家或市场。监管标准越高、覆盖越广，该国家或市场的风险敞口得分越高。
